title: Paul McCartney live: HP Pavilion, San Jose | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the HP Pavilion in San Jose, California, USA, on 7 November 2005.

It was the 26th show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005, and the first of two consecutive nights in San Jose.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the HP Pavilion during the Driving World Tour on 3 April and 22 October 2002. He returned there during the Freshen Up Tour on 10 July 2019.
